headline: John Glenn returns to space at 77
post_facts: Oldest person in space at the time

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen ninety-eight... John Glenn returned to space, at seventy-seven.

scenes.label: Kennedy Space Center
scenes.caption: Space Shuttle Discovery, mission STS-95
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He launched aboard Space Shuttle Discovery.

scenes.label: after his first orbit, in 1962
scenes.text: [calmly] Thirty-six years earlier, he had become the first American to orbit the Earth.

scenes.label: Friendship 7, 1962
scenes.caption: Glenn in his Mercury spacesuit
scenes.text: [softly] He was now the oldest person yet to fly in space.

scenes.title: A flying lab for aging
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] For nine days, doctors studied how spaceflight affects an aging body.

scenes.title: Would you go to space at 77?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you go to space at seventy-seven?
